'''''Amongst the rot and filth of scum is the Shadow Temple. No one dares venture into it or speak of its accursed name, for it is a symbol of pure evil. The Sages themselves consider sending it into the underworld.'''''
{{-}}

==The Path to Shadows==
[[File:LOZ OOT Sheikah Sealing Chamber.PNG|thumb|right|There are torches all over this chamber.]]‎
Return to the Temple of Time and retrieve the Master Sword (make sure you have the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}!), then play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Nocturne of Shadow}} and warp to the Graveyard. You'll end up somewhere new: a ledge high above the graveyard beyond the Royal Family's Tomb. Head down the tunnel behind you. 
{{-}}
[[File:LOZ OOT Open Shadow.PNG|thumb|left|Cast Din's Fire...]]
[[File:LOZ OOT Shadow Temple Opens.PNG|thumb|right|...and enter at your own risk.]]‎
You'll come to a large chamber with a spellcasting circle and unlit torches. At the end of this room is a large sealed door. Stand in the center platform and use {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} to light all of the torches at once. The
door will rise up and reveal the path forward. 

You are now free to enter the Shadow Temple. However, once you enter this temple, your fears will be put to the test...
{{Zelda/MQ|Shadow Temple}}
{{-}}

==The Shadow Temple==
[[File:LOZ OOT Shadow Temple Intro.PNG|thumb|left|250px|The Shadow Temple, land of nightmares.]] 
The Shadow Temple is a dark, unforgiving dungeon filled with some of the nastiest monsters in Hyrule. You'll need to be wary of your surroundings to escape this nightmare land alive.
{{-|left}}

Warning: It would be near impossible to complete this dungeon without the '''Lens of Truth'''. Especially the boss battle at the end as you might find it hard to find the enemy without it. Also, make sure your magic meter is full and learn to use its power wisely in this unique dungeon.

====Dark Trickery====
Once you are inside, go forward and use the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} to get past the gap. It looks like a dead end, but it isn't. Just put on the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}, and go past the wall. In this room turn left and put on the Lens of Truth to reveal another fake wall. Go through this wall and open the door at the end of the corridor. You will enter a hallway that wraps around in a circle with eyes in the walls. Now keep to your right and follow the path around, entering the first fake door you find on the right hand side. 

Enter the door and kill the one {{im/oot|Enemies|ReDead}} and two {{im/oot|Enemies|Keese}} in this room to get the {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Dungeon Map}}. Leave the room and head right again, entering through the next fake wall, which leads into another room identical to the one you were just in. At the end of this room is a fake wall with a door behind it. Enter the door to get to the next room containing the {{im/oot|Enemies|Dead Hand}}.

===Dead Hand's Revenge===
[[File:LOZ OOT ST Deadhand Returns.PNG|thumb|left|Dead Hand's back; you know what to do!]]
In here, you'll fight {{im/oot|Enemies|Dead Hand}} again. Fight him the same way you did before to kill him. However, Dead Hand has taken further precaution against you and several more hands now stand in this room. On the plus side, the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} will allow you to see a shadow on the ground to see where the monster is hiding. Use a {{im/oot|Items|Bomb|display=bomb}} on the shadow to lure the monster out of the ground and away from his hands to strike him down. 
{{-}}
[[File:TLoZ-OOT Hover Boots Artwork.png|left]]
[[File:LOZ OOT ST Hover Boots.PNG|thumb|right|You got the Hover Boots!]]‎
Once you do, a chest will appear like before, only this one contains the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}}. These boots have built-in hovering capabilities that allow you to walk across pits and reach inaccessible areas. However, the boots have no traction and only work for brief periods of time. Now leave and head back to the main room.
{{-}}

===Descent into Darkness===
====Skull of Truth====
[[File:LOZ OOT ST Raven.PNG|thumb|left|This statue must face the Skull of Truth.]]
[[File:LOZ OOT ST Skull of Truth.PNG|thumb|right|Push it to face the ''real'' skull!]] ‎
In the main room there is a circle of skull torches around a bird statue. There is also a locked door that seems unreachable. It will open if you move the statue. It says to face its beak towards the Skull of Truth or descend into darkness. Put the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} on and see the real skull. The rest are illusions. Now, push the statue until it is aligned with the correct skull to make the door open. If it isn't, run away, because the floor surrounding the statue is a trapdoor. 
{{-}}
When you've pointed the statue at the right skull, they will all light up, and the door at the end of the chasm will open. Put on the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} and run straight as far as the boots will take you to get to the doorway. Go through it and down the passage, where you'll reach a {{im/oot|Enemies|Big Beamos}}. This one requires two {{im/oot|Items|Bombs|display=bombs}} to destroy instead of one. Once you destroy it Navi will go green in the center of the room. If you play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}}, a fairy will appear.

You may think you've run into a dead end, but don't be fooled; the Dungeon Map and the Lens of Truth reveal several hidden corridors. Go through the fake wall on the right and enter the next room.

====Gibdos and the Compass====
There is a new enemy here; a {{im/oot|Enemies|Gibdo}}. You've seen one in the well, but this is the first time you must truly battle them. They use bone-rattling shrieks like ReDeads do, and only attack when they hear you getting too close to them, but their screeches inflict paralysis longer, and they suck away more life energy when they bind you. Get caught by one, and it will steal ½ a heart of your health a second rather than a fourth. Defeat the two Gibdos here to get the {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Compass}}.

;Three easy ways to defeat the two Gibdos
*Freeze them by playing the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} as soon as you enter the room.
*Two hits from {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} will defeat them. They also tend to give you magic when they die, so your magic meter may be filled afterwards.
*One charged spin attack with {{im/oot|Equipment|Biggoron's Sword}}.

After you get the Compass, exit the room and walk straight across. Be careful because the Big Beamos will respawn when you renter the room.

====Silver Rupees, Evil Reapers====
In this room there are a bunch of {{im/oot|Consumables|Silver Rupee|display=Silver Rupees}} and a scythe trap. You'll have to keep ducking to avoid getting carved up. Stay on the outer regions of the scythe, because you'll still get hit if you duck right next to the reaper statues. Collect all of the Silver Rupees in here to move on. Use the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} and {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} to reach the highest one in the far corner. Your reward is a {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Small Key}}, which can be found in the alcove on the right as you come in the room, having opened up. Return to the last room with the Beamos. Turn to your left and bomb the wall of bones. You'll find a locked door you can open.

===Skulltula corridor===
If you like spiders, then this next area of the dungeon is a thrill. Carefully go down the hallway and watch out for the numerous {{im/oot|Enemies|Big Skulltula}}. Your best bet is to hit each one with the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} and go on.

Eventually, you reach a corridor with falling guillotine blades. Keep a close eye on the blades and time your runs through them. Some are a little faster than others in the temple. 

Keep going until you reach the end of the corridor. Here, the path opens up into a cavern with a bottomless pit. There are several hidden, moving, and blade-trapped platforms. There is a {{im/oot|Enemies|Wallmaster}} lurking about, so if it comes after you and it gets you, you'll end up back at the temple entrance. If you have {{im/oot|Items|Farore's Wind}}, it would be a good idea to create a warp point here.

Put on the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} and carefully make your way through the falling blades to the platform on the other side. A {{im/oot|Enemies|Red Bubble}} will hop out at you, but one {{im/oot|Items|Deku Nut}} will stun it. Try not to get into conflict with the {{im/oot|Enemies|Stalfos}} that will appear. If you defeat it Navi will indicate another spot to play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} for a Fairy. Now, you can either progress onward, or seek out a Gold Skulltula.

===[[File:OOT skulltula small.png|25px]]Imprisoned Skulltula[[File:OOT skulltula small.png|25px]]===
Turn to your left and put on the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}. There are hidden platforms leading somewhere. Use your Hover Boots to get across the area. Enter the door you come to. 

This room has a hidden scythe trap, {{im/oot|Enemies|Keese}}, and an annoying {{im/oot|Enemies|Like-Like}}. Kill all the enemies in here, and a small area will open up. Inside is a {{im/oot|Enemies|Gold Skulltula}}. Not just that, but two treasure chests. One you can see right away.

The first chest holds a {{im/oot|Consumables|Blue Rupee}} and the other holds a {{im/oot|Consumables|Arrow|display=bundle of arrows}}. Use the Lens of Truth to unveil it. Lastly, you will find two floating {{im/oot|Consumables|Recovery Heart|display=hearts}} in the corner of the room. These are obtained by playing the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Time}} next to them. When you're done here, exit and go back to the platform with the {{im/oot|Enemies|Stalfos}}.

===Opening Doors of Doom===
Kill the {{im/oot|Enemies|Stalfos}} if you haven't already, and then look to the one side that you haven't been yet. There is a moving platform. Time yourself so that when it is at its lowest point, jump onto it. Jump from there as it rises onto the platform with the {{im/oot|Consumables|Silver Rupee|display=Silver Rupees}}, but run as far as you can to make it. Or you can turn right and jump onto the ledge there, then go left. There are two Spike Traps circling around a {{im/oot|Enemies|Beamos}}. All but one of the Silver Rupees are either in the path of the traps or near the Beamos. The last one is under the Beamos. Blow the Beamos up to get that one to open and then enter the next room. 

====Spikes, Spikes, and Monster Spikes====
This is the giant spike trap room. Once you come in, a sign will mention a stone umbrella. You'll need it to get past these spikes, as a foolish effort to run under them will cost you one heart. Put on your {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} and look to your right. There is a stone block in the wall. Pull it out, and then push it towards the falling spikes. It will catch the spikes and let you pass under them unharmed. Once it is holding both of the spikes so they can't hit you, explore the second jail cell to find a {{im/oot|Enemies|Gold Skulltula}}.

Then, go around to the other side and pull the block as far as you can take it. It now serves as a bridge onto the spikes. Get on top of it and walk onto the top of the spikes it's by. Across the room on the roof of a jail cell is a switch. Use your {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} to get there and press the switch. Although they are moving and slanted on top, you can walk across the top of the spikes. After the switch is pressed, a treasure chest will fall. Hook onto it with your Longshot and open it for a {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Small Key}}, then leave the room. There is another chest with a {{im/oot|Consumables|Blue Rupee}} on another cell roof, and some {{im/oot|Consumables|Recovery Heart|display=Recovery Hearts}} in the first jail cell, but they aren't really worth the effort.

Go back to the location of the Beamos and spike traps. You'll see a small strech of pathway branches to the left and stops at a guillotine. Put on your Lens of Truth and you will see a new platform. Get onto it after dodging the guillotine. The next platform is shifting across a string of chains. Carefully time crossing over to it and go and ride it over to the locked door. 

====Hidden Deathtraps====
This room is very dangerous, although it doesn't look like it. Two {{im/oot|Enemies|ReDead}} are here, so play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} and kill them. This will put their souls at rest, and a chest with a {{im/oot|Consumables|Blue Rupee}} inside will appear in return. Now, you will need to use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}, because columns of hidden spikes are littered throughout this room. If you wear the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} you will automatically walk over them with out damage, but you can't just stand on them. There are also {{im/oot|Consumables|Silver Rupee|display=Silver Rupees}} you need in this room. Use the Lens of Truth to see hidden platforms and Longshot targets to get the Silver Rupees without doing yourself any harm.

====Destroy the Skull Pot====
{{OoT Skulltula|title=A Gold Skulltula|width=200px||contents=On the left side wall next to the skull pot is a Gold Skulltula.}}
Enter the door that opens in this room. Climb up the stairs in this next room and pick up a Bomb Flower growing at the top of the stairs. Throw it in the flaming skull pot. When it explodes, the pot will explode as well, shooting out a {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Small Key}} inside. Get it and kill the {{im/oot|Enemies|Keese}} and {{im/oot|Enemies|Fire Keese}} in the room to open the door so you can get out of here and back to the last room. Use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} on the ceiling to see a {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} target. Latch onto the target to land on a ledge above and enter the locked door there.
{{-}}

===Fight the Blowing Fans===
{{sidebar|title=A Big Fairy and a Hint|width=300px||contents=The room you do not need to enter has two {{im/oot|Enemies|ReDead}} inside. First, play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} and kill them. Second, go to the center of the room, play the song again to make a Big Fairy appear. Third, use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} to unveil a chest containing arrows. And fourth, if you look at the skull portrait on the wall, Navi will fly up to it, and if you listen to her, she'll tell you what the portrait is saying.}}

This next room is a narrow corridor filled with danger. {{im/oot|Enemies|Big Skulltula}} constantly drop down from above in this room. Not only that, blowing fans threaten to send you flying. Use your {{im/oot|Equipment|Iron Boots}} to make it through the strong winds the fans are making, or wait for them to stop and use your {{im/oot|Equipment|Kokiri Boots}} to run through. Go past the first fan and the spike trap, and watch for Big Skulltula in the corridor as well. Now, you'll have to cross a pit with a fan on the other side. 

Use either the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} or the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} on a wooden beam above the other side to get across. Then, you'll encounter more fans and Big Skulltula. When you get past them, you'll reach the end of the corridor, which will have a dropoff and a fan above. Jump down. Finally, you'll reach a part of the room with fans on both sides and one straight platform in the middle. Use your Iron Boots to get across. You don't need to enter the room ahead. There is a {{im/oot|Enemies|Fake Eye Switch}} at the end that will shoot fire at you. To make it stop, blind it with an arrow when it's open.
{{-}}

== Don't Go Through The Door ==
Once you get to the other side of the platform, turn to the left and use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}. Look to the wall and you'll see a hidden doorway. Equip the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} and run to it when the fan behind you is blowing. The extra boost from the wind will allow you to get to the door. Unlock it and go in.

====Gibdos Guarding the Key====
In this room there is a pile of bones in the right-hand corner. As soon as you enter, {{im/oot|Items|Bomb|display=bomb}} the bones. Then, use your {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} to find a treasure chest with a {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Small Key}} inside. Beyond you are two {{im/oot|Enemies|Gibdo|display=Gibdos}} and two Spike Traps. Play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} and kill them, and they will leave behind a chest holding a {{im/oot|Consumables|Blue Rupee}}. Go past the traps and through the locked door.

====A Ferry to the Other World====
You are now in a room with a large ship. There is a block to your left. Pull it and push it along a small rut in the floor to a ladder on a nearby wall so you can reach it. There are vines behind where the block was originally covering that you can climb up to go into the cage. There are more vines that continue higher--do not go up these vines! There is nothing up there but a door that leads to the old room with the scythe (the one with the first set of Silver Rupees). Once you go inside, the block will reset so you cannot go back down the way you came. If this happens to you, go the lowest cage you can reach and cast {{im/oot|Items|Farore's Wind}}, then use it to warp back to the door you just came in, otherwise you'll have to go through the whole temple again! However it's better to just move the block into place by the ladder and then save to permanently open this shortcut.

{{sidebar|title=Gold Skulltula and Scarecrow|width=350px||contents=If you remember your {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Scarecrow's Song}}, you can play that and the scarecrow will appear. Use your {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}} to reach the scarecrow and pull yourself towards the Gold Skulltula and two hearts. However, you can use the Longshot to reach it from the edge of the ship.}}
Once you've moved the block into place, climb up the ladder and jump onto the ship. Play {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Zelda's Lullaby}} on the Triforce symbol on the ship to make it start moving. Keep an eye on your map in the corner. The moment you get the ship moving, a {{im/oot|Enemies|Stalfos}} will drop down onto the ship. After a while, so will a second one. If you have it, use {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} to kill them instantly or hang off of the edge of the ship and they will jump off as they try to move around you. Otherwise, fight them one by one. Whatever you do, don't jump into the murky water below, or you'll end up back at the start of the room.

Eventually the ship will go as far is it can. When it does, it will sink, and Navi will tell you to abandon ship. Jump off the ship and onto the nearby ledge. If you look back at the ship, you'll see it sink completely, meaning you're stuck here for now. Enter the door that is at the end of the ledge.

====Maze of the Floormasters====
When you enter this room, you will need to use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}. The room is actually filled with hidden walls that form a maze. The Lens of Truth will reveal them. Be very alert while you go through the maze, because a horde of {{im/oot|Enemies|Floormaster|display=Floormasters}} patrol the floor. However, if you turn the Lens of Truth off, you can see where the Floormasters are and can even kill them through the wall! 

The maze leads to three other doors besides the one you came from. You'd be smart to cast {{im/oot|Items|Farore's Wind}} here. This will mark the exit and get you out of trouble later. Go through the maze and use the Compass and Dungeon Map to find a door in the south corner of the room.

====Floormaster Cloaked by Shadows====
In this next room, the door will lock behind you. You've ventured into a frightening torture chamber where many poor souls were whipped. If you look around, no enemy can be seen in this room, or so it seems. Put on the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} and you'll see a {{im/oot|Enemies|Floormaster}}. Don't take the lens off, or else it will disappear. Slash it to make it split into its smaller versions and kill them to make a chest with a {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Small Key}} inside appear. The doors will unlock, and you can move on. 

*Tip: If you have {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}}, use it as soon as you destroy the big Floormaster, that way it will kill all the babies before they have a chance to get big again.

====Face Death For The Boss Key==== 
Return to the maze and guide yourself to a door in the north corner of the room. Go in and you'll face this dungeon's ultimate deathtrap: two walls covered with spikes, and they're closing in to get you! It may seem like there isn't a way to destroy these walls, but there is. The walls are made of shoddy, rotting wood, and are very flammable. 

Use {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} to light the wood on fire and destroy the walls. However, you'll find two {{im/oot|Enemies|ReDead}} in the room's corners. Play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} to stun them and then kill them. There are two chests in this room; the chest to the west holds a {{im/oot|Consumables|Blue Rupee}}, and the chest to the East contains the {{im/oot|Dungeon Items|Boss Key}}.

====Topple the Gargoyle====
{{OoT Skulltula|title=The North Door|float=left|width=250px||contents=The last door in the maze room in the west corner has three spinning skull pots inside. Like before, on the left side wall next to the pots is a Gold Skulltula.}}
{{sidebar|title=Rupee Reward!|width=350px||contents=If you stick around in the west corner room of the maze after killing the {{im/oot|Enemies|Gold Skulltula}} inside, you can destroy the three skull pots spinning around with Bomb Flowers. Once all three are destroyed, a pile of Rupees will spill out! You just hit the jackpot!}}

Go out of this room and out of the maze room completely (through the door in the east corner, or warp back to it to save time) so that you're back at the ledge where the ship sank. If you look across the ledge, you'll see another ledge on the other side of a big pit. The only problem is, you can't reach it. Take out the {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Bow}} and look around. You'll find a gargoyle statue with Bomb Flowers under it. Shoot one with an arrow to make the rest explode, which will break the gargoyle statue and cause it to topple across the pit. 

You now have a bridge to cross the pit. Make your way to the other ledge, and you'll find a locked door. However, you have a way of replenishing health if you must. There is another ruined gargoyle statue (you probably saw its head buried in the dirt earlier) with two {{im/oot|Consumables|Recovery Heart|display=Recovery Hearts}}. Use the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Time}} to reveal a time block and get them. Need more? Play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Scarecrow's Song}} here to get Pierre's assistance. Hook onto him and get the hearts here as well. Now, you are ready to open the locked door. Go inside and your journey through the shadows will near its end.

====Find Your Way Through the Dark====
This next room is the last one before the Boss room, and you can even see the door right ahead of you! The only problem is, it's the ''only'' thing you can see in this room, besides the door behind you. To fix this problem, use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}}. Several small platforms will appear. Cross onto them with the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} to make it to the Boss door. Open this door and you'll be in a dark room littered with bones. There is also a hole in this room. Drop down to face the nightmarish Boss.

==Boss: Bongo Bongo==
You will find yourself on a platform in the dark and see a hand come down and hit it, bouncing you up. Then another hand will appear and hit the platform. The hands will pound on the platform and then you'll find out that it is actually a giant bongo drum you are standing on. Then the giant dark monster from before will appear and will form into the body that the hands come from.

{{boss|name=Phantom Shadow Beast: BONGO BONGO
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Bongo Bongo.png
|imagesize=300px
|text=This is a boss that can be dangerous. If you have a {{im/oot|Items|Fairy's Spirit|display=Fairy}} or {{im/oot|Items|Red Potion}} with you, they'll come in handy. If you have the {{im/oot|Equipment|Biggoron's Sword}}, things will be much easier. You fight Bongo Bongo on his giant bongo drum, which is a challenge. Wear the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hover Boots}} to avoid being bounced around too much by the beat of the drum. Be sure to be aware at the start of the battle and after you attack his eye, because he will turn his hands around then when he stays still he will attack you. First you will see his two hands, which will be beating on the drum constantly while the rest of him vanishes. His hands try to swat, punch, and grab you; so make sure you keep an eye on both hands so that one doesn't get you by surprise. 
{{YouTube|video=v-ElHNtLKEE|title=Bongo Bongo|duration=4:06}}

Try your best to not get knocked off the bongo, since there's a pool of sinister poison down below. If you get thrown off, climb up the side of the drum to get back up. You have to shoot both of the hands with arrows or the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}}. This can be difficult because you're thrown up and down by the beating of the drum, so the best time to get them is when they try to hit you. Once you have shot both hands, activate the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} and you will see Bongo Bongo's face. {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}|{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-Target and hit his eye with an arrow or the Longshot. Be sure to do this fast, or else he'll try to ram you off the side. Then run up to him and hit him with your sword as many times as possible. 

An alternate tactic is to get the {{im/oot|Items|Ice Arrows}} before facing Bongo Bongo and use them on one of his hands. The monster will be forced to smash his frozen hand free with the other one and its eye will be open while he does this, leaving it open to attack as well. Another method is to do a spin attack when he charges at you, this will hit the eye and stun him. Once you've given Bongo Bongo the boot, he will pound his drum one last time and melt into poison. Don't worry, the poison evaporates. Get the {{im/oot|Upgrades|Heart Container}} and you can finally leave this scary temple of nightmares.}}

==Impa's Message==
[[File:OOT_Shadow_Medallion.png|150px|right]]
You will be transported to the Chamber of the Sages after stepping into the blue light. There you will be re-acquainted with Impa, who has become the Sage of Shadow. After a few compliments, she tells you that you will meet the princess again soon, and she will explain everything. She grants you the '''<font color="Purple">Shadow Medallion</font>''', which contains her power.
{{-}}

==Sidequests==
<div style="float:right; padding-left:1em">{{Zelda PoH|title=Three Quarters of a Heart to Receive|width=300px|contents=You can get almost a full heart:
*'''Market''': If you haven't already, go to the Treasure Box Shop in Hyrule (It is only open at night.) The game costs ten rupees. You go through each room guessing which of two chests has the key required to get you into the next room (You have a 1 out of 32 chance of winning.). Now, you can use the {{im/oot|Items|Lens of Truth}} to see through the chests and get to the Piece of Heart at the end with ease. A secret trick is to open all the chests on the right when you first play. They might all contain keys.
*'''Zora's River''': Play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} to the frogs on the log near the Blue Tektites, and they'll give you a Piece of Heart. 
*'''Zora's River''': Complete the bug-catching game with the musical frogs to earn a Piece of Heart. See [[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time/Minigames|the minigame section]] for further details.}} 

{{OoT Skulltula|title=Even More Gold Skulltula!|width=300px|contents=You can find a many more skulltulla now:
*'''Hyrule Castle''' (child): Enter the main Hyrule Castle area and make your way to the small moat. In the nearby corner is a lone tree. Stand beneath it and play the {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Song of Storms}} to reveal a grotto. Use {{im/oot|Items|Bomb|display=Bombs}} to destroy the walls until you find a Gold Skulltula. Note: This Gold Skulltula location can be abused to get an infinite number of Gold Skulltula Tokens. See [[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time|Glitches]] for more details. 
*'''Kakariko Village''' (adult): This Skulltula is on the roof of Impa's house. To get there, stand in front of the door of that house and {{im/oot|Items|Hookshot}} over to the roof of the House of Skulltula. Then, Hookshot onto the roof of Impa's house. This is easier with the {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}}, but it can be done without. (nighttime only)
*'''Shadow Temple''': In the room with the scythe-trap, destroy all the enemies to open the area with the key in the chest. Above it, there is a Gold Skultulla.
*'''Shadow Temple''': Amongst the cages in the giant spike trap room, one has a Gold Skulltula inside.
*'''Shadow Temple''': In the ship room, before doing anything with the block, look up the cage platform. A Gold Skulltula and a couple of hearts are here. The Longshot will allow you access to them.}}
</div>

===Another Hylian Shield!===
If you do not have the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hylian Shield}} yet, you have an opportunity to get one. Inside the well is a room with a {{im/oot|Enemies|Fire Keese}} and {{im/oot|Enemies|Beamos}}. Go into the door behind them and there will be a {{im/oot|Enemies|Like-Like}} inside. Kill it to get Rupees, and open the chest to get a Hylian Shield.
